before.prompt: In sentence s2, 'While the work is underway, the escalator will be out of service,' what does 'out of service' mean?

options.text: It means the escalator will run more slowly during the morning rush.
options.explanation: Wrong because running slowly still means working, not unavailable for use.

options.text: It means the escalator will not be working and cannot be used.
options.explanation: Correct because it matches not working or not available for use.

options.text: It means the escalator will be open only for station staff.
options.explanation: Wrong because limited access for staff still means working, not unavailable for use.

before.explanation: The context is that passengers cannot use the escalator during the work.

after.prompt: In sentence s2, 'While the work is underway, the escalator will be out of service,' what does 'out of service' mean?

options.text: It means the escalator will stay open for passengers but run more slowly during the morning rush.
options.explanation: Wrong: the notice directs passengers to the lifts while work is underway; it does not say they can keep using the escalator at a slower speed.

options.text: It means passengers will not be able to use the escalator while the work is underway.
options.explanation: Correct: the notice directs passengers to the lifts, so the escalator is unavailable to them during the work.

options.text: It means the escalator will be free for passengers to use during the maintenance work.
options.explanation: Wrong: the notice directs passengers to the lifts during the work, so it does not say the escalator remains available to passengers.

after.explanation: Here, out of service means passengers cannot use the escalator during the maintenance; the notice tells them to use the lifts.

edits.finding: gpt-6.1-sol final: unresolved uncertain issue — out-of-service can mean unavailable to passengers even if the unit may still operate; the original explanation overclaimed that restricted staff access means available for use, and option b conjoined the two alternatives in the gloss. Reframed all options and evidence around passenger availability during maintenance.
